# Proof-Carrying Science

Proof-Carrying Science (PCS) is an AI-safety-first, domain-general assurance system for consequential computation. It packages an exact typed claim with exact artifacts, assumptions, replay evidence, cryptographic bindings, machine-checked assurance, and reviewer-owned acceptance policy. The PCS AI Safety Commons adds a public-good contributor model for bounded, verifiable safety work.

Canonical site: https://proof-carrying-science-site.marenatommaso.workers.dev/

## Important interpretation
A PCS-valid package is scoped to an exact typed claim, exact evidence, and explicit assumptions. PCS does not claim that package validity establishes arbitrary biological, clinical, empirical, or regulatory truth. Production v0.6 validity is Lean-authoritative; browser tools are educational, discovery, or inspection surfaces unless explicitly stated otherwise.


## Commons interpretation
The contributor marketplace is currently a static/manual-coordination pilot. Local profile/task state remains in the browser; task requests prepare email rather than creating a server-side assignment. Proposed bounties are not payable unless a task is explicitly marked funded and PCS confirms written terms. Contributor submissions never become assurance merely because they were submitted: the commons principle is "crowdsource the work, never the truth."
